data.title: Github Co-Pilot
data.content: Github Co-pilot, which is built on OpenAI's Codex model, works as an autocomplete for writing code, partially automating or assisting in the identification of existing libraries, APIs etc required as constituents of the prompted task. The Codex model is trained to translate natural language to code in over a dozen programming languages including Python, JavaScript, Go, Perl and Ruby, among others. Because neither the model nor the data it is trained on is open source, it is difficult to assess the likely range of variation, however it has been speculated that it was trained on open source code. If this is the case, it could be argued that this tool derives value from public resource. It is highly interoperable, though, compatible with multiple text editors.

data.title: Unity ML-Agents Toolkit
data.content: The Unity Machine Learning Agents Toolkit (ML-Agents) is an open-source project that enables games and simulations to serve as environments for training intelligent agents'. The tool is interently interoperable, allowing ML to be used in direct conjunction with Unity games engine to produce wide-ranging outcomes. According to the developers, 'Unity provide implementations (based on PyTorch) of state-of-the-art algorithms to enable game developers and hobbyists to easily train intelligent agents for 2D, 3D and VR/AR games. Researchers can also use the provided simple-to-use Python API to train Agents using reinforcement learning, imitation learning, neuroevolution, or any other methods. These trained agents can be used for multiple purposes, including controlling NPC behavior, automated testing of game builds and evaluating different game design decisions pre-release'.

data.title: On the Philosophy of Unsupervised Learning
YOLO
data.content: YOLO uses machine vision to detect objects in an image. By dividing an image into 'regions' it uses single-shot algorithms to identify multiple objects of interest using a convolutional neural network.

data.title: Holly+
data.content: Developed by Holly Herndon in collaboration with Never Before Heard Sounds. A Voice Model which transforms uploaded audio clips into outputs recreated in likeness of Holly Herndon's voice. The Holly+ Model is a neural network trained by the artist, the first of its kind. It acts as a proof-of-concept for the need for artists to produce their own models using 'high fidelity vocal training data' which can compete with low quality models trained using public domain recordings, and of which they have initial ownership and creative control. Ownership of the model will be distributed through the Holly+ DAO.
